answer: Lock each identity's rewards in outcome escrow: 110 POA for 50 days, released only after three users confirm the work was useful. Auditors open a live-attention window; each identity must answer a prompt within 90 seconds, and one operator cannot answer many at once. A second identity from the same funder locks 220 POA and needs six confirmations, a third 440 POA and nine, so cost doubles per fake. The fable of free identities ends where the plume of cheap sign-ups meets a summit of verified usefulness: auditors verify locks, confirmations and timing, slashing 30% of stakes for copied work.
